definition: The phase of a [minion wave](/term/wave) that occurs after it [crashes](/term/crash) into the opposing team’s tower. During a bounceback, the opposing minions will outnumber the allied minions, forcing the wave to push back towards the allied tower. Bouncebacks are a period of higher [tension](/term/tension) during the lane phase because a death from either side results in more lost minions than an even wave. Bouncebacks can result in a [freeze](/term/freeze).
